title: Moisturiser for Acne-Prone Skin: How to Choose One and Use It Day and Night
ex: Why acne-prone skin still needs moisturiser, how to pick a light non-comedogenic one, and a full morning and night routine with salicylic acid.
rt: Moisturiser for Acne-Prone Skin: How to Choose | Mirc Glow
rd: How to choose a moisturiser for acne prone skin in India, plus a simple day and night routine for blackheads, whiteheads and salicylic acid use.
quick: Acne-prone skin still needs moisturiser. Choose a light, non-comedogenic gel or gel-cream, use a thin layer morning and night, and pair it with a gentle cleanser and daily sunscreen. If you use salicylic acid, start 3–4 times a week and always moisturise after.
facts: Oily skin can still be short on water.
Salicylic acid is oil-soluble and works inside the pore lining.
Patch test a new moisturiser for about a week.
Give a new routine 4–6 weeks before judging it.
